name: NVIDIA Triton Inference Server Open Source
free_limit: BSD-3-Clause open-source inference server for serving TensorRT, ONNX, PyTorch, TensorFlow and other models over HTTP/gRPC with dynamic batching; no software request quota.
watch_out: Run and pay for your own CPU/GPU machines, model weights, networking and storage; no hosted inference credits included. Some optimized backends, hardware drivers and NVIDIA AI Enterprise services have separate licenses or costs.
